thread:
elaine.k: Quick check — we need one tight hero and one long-form section for the tri-mode pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). Thinking: 1) single-line belief-led headline, 2) subhead that calls out latency + cost, 3) CTA matrix (demo vs try).
samir: Agreed. Could we run two hero variants in the A/B and the long form stays consistent?
olga: Yes. Hero A: `Ship LLM features without guessing about cost or latency.` Hero B: `Predictable, low-latency LLM inference for products.` Which feels clearer?
ben_marketing: I like A for product teams, B for infra/platform buyers. Might be worth routing based on utm or first-touch.
elaine.k: Good call. We'll show Hero A by default and Hero B when utm_source=platform or on the Dedicated/Private routing. Also want a micro-benchmark blurb below hero.
marketing-bot: :information_source: New benchmark asset uploaded: `benchmarks/2026-03-inference-latency-summary.pdf`
samir: Perfect. For the micro-benchmark blurb copy: `Median 95ms per token on Hosted, predictable tail latency for Dedicated, and private VPC deployment options.` Keep it punchy.
olga: Draft long-form section outline: 1) What you get (latency, cost controls, SLAs), 2) How it works (runtime + caching + routing), 3) Customer stories, 4) CTA + gating.
ben_marketing: For gating/inbound routing — option A: one consolidated form with product interest checkbox; option B: three CTAs that hit different forms (hosted trial, talk to sales - dedicated, private deployment inquiry). Pros/cons?
elaine.k: Option B gives better lead routing but adds friction. Maybe show three CTAs visually but map them to two forms: try/hosted (self-serve) vs contact (sales for Dedicated/Private). Use hidden `interest=dedicated` param for CTA clicks.
samir: Implementation note for eng: add hidden query `?interest=dedicated` and map to HubSpot property `product_interest`. QA: make sure webhook preserves that.
olga: I'll write the microcopy for each CTA: `Try Hosted (free credits)`, `Reserve Dedicated (SLA-ready)`, `Request Private Deployment`. Short and clear.
ben_marketing: Webinar tie-in: host a benchmark walkthrough + migration playbook. CTA in long form: `Join webinar — Benchmarking inference at scale`. Add a short 30s teaser video.
elaine.k: Timeline: draft next Monday, creative assets by Wed, dev attach tracking by Friday. Samir — can you confirm routing feasibility?
samir: Yep — can have the hidden param and HubSpot mapping by Fri EOD. Will add tests.
olga: I'll post copy snippets in Figma and tag for review.
elaine.k: Awesome. If everyone can drop one line by EOD Thursday on which hero to push for the webinar landing, we'll finalize. :thumbsup:
